label: Agroforestry
definition: Deliberate growing of trees on land also used for crops or livestock
synonyms: agro-forestry;parkland;alley cropping;shade trees;silvopastoral;FMNR;farmer managed natural regeneration
notes: Covers several sub-practices. Record the sub-practice in detail rather than splitting the code.

label: Conservation agriculture
definition: Minimum soil disturbance with permanent soil cover and crop rotation
notes: A paper reporting only one of the three principles is still coded here. Say which in detail.

label: Improved fallows
definition: Planted fallow of nitrogen fixing species between cropping cycles
synonyms: planted fallow;fallow enrichment;rotational fallow;sesbania fallow;tephrosia fallow

label: Biochar
definition: Pyrolysed biomass applied to soil as an amendment

label: Cover crops
definition: Crop grown to cover the soil rather than to be harvested
notes: Separate from conservation agriculture even though it is one of its principles. Code the paper by what it studies.

label: Drought tolerant varieties
definition: Crop varieties bred for yield stability under water stress
synonyms: drought resistant variety;stress tolerant maize;DTMA;improved variety
notes: Adoption rates are common here and costs are rare. Both are in scope.

label: Water harvesting
definition: Capture and concentration of rainfall or runoff for crop use
notes: In situ and ex situ both belong here. Say which in detail.

label: Other
definition: An adaptation practice not covered by the codes above
notes: Never guess. A row coded other is listed for the team in the review sheet so the vocabulary can be extended.
